fluff.overview: A large mob signals a serious breakdown in civil order, with hundreds of armed civilians operating as a collective force driven by shared fury. Armed with makeshift rifles, improvised weapons, and incendiary grenades, a mob of this size can overrun isolated military patrols, seize government buildings, and hold ground long enough to force a significant armed response. What large mobs lack in training they compensate for with mass and momentum. Suppressing them requires committing troops that garrison commanders would rather deploy elsewhere, and heavy-handed responses risk turning sympathetic bystanders into active participants. Large mobs have disrupted military operations on dozens of worlds during the Succession Wars and beyond.
